Comment: Bucket policy for the ubuntu-ami sample's per-run S3 staging bucket. setup.sh renders @STAGE_BUCKET@ and applies it right after it creates the bucket (Block Public Access on, default SSE-S3 encryption, tags ManagedBy and RunId). It refuses every request that does not use TLS. It grants nothing: the operator's credentials upload, and the build-host role reads only through its own per-run inline policy (deploy/iam-build-host-policy.json).
